role.altitude: The art therapist keeps observing clients, choosing techniques and media, setting goals with clients and preparing the studio; typing session notes and arranging consultations by mail shrink a little.
role.ambitious_version: A therapist whose notes are done before the next client arrives.

tasks.short: Observe client reactions during sessions, document reactions, progress and outcomes in the session note, check and sign it, and attach artwork photos.

steps.what: Art therapist observes client reactions and progress during art therapy
Art therapist documents client reactions, progress and outcomes in the session note

loop.input: The therapist's spoken summary after the session.
loop.output: A draft session note in the record's template with reactions, progress per treatment goal and outcomes.
loop.check: Goals named must exist in the client's plan; the therapist corrects the draft line by line.
loop.stop: The therapist signs the note, or types it by hand when the draft is poor.
loop.why_not_simpler: Spoken summaries vary in order and wording.

steps.what: Art therapist checks and signs the session note
Art therapist attaches photos of the client's artwork to the record

tasks.design: Observing stays fully with the therapist. After the session the therapist speaks a short summary, and a speech-to-note step drafts the note in the record's template, with progress listed against the client's treatment goals. The therapist corrects and signs it. Only the therapist's summary is recorded, never the session, and the audio is deleted once the note is signed. Photographing artwork belongs to another task and is priced there.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notes were typed after each session.
tasks.enabler_now: Speech-to-note tools that write into the patient record.
tasks.still_hard: Group sessions with many clients to describe.
tasks.human_edge: Noticing a small change in how a client uses colour.

reach.learn: Whether notes are in the record the same day.

evidence.claim: A Dutch speech-to-note tool lets the clinician validate the note before it goes into the patient record.
Across 236,153 scribe notes, self-estimated time per note fell 29%; three of seven authors from the vendor.
Providers are legally responsible for careful use of generative AI.

assumptions: Boundary: observing and documenting sessions; writing progress reports (task 19154) and interpreting artwork (task 19150) are sibling tasks.
s4 is part of photographing artwork for records, which sibling task 19152 covers; its saving is counted there.
s2 is priced at the 29% cut per note in the scribe study.
Observing and signing keep their full time.
research_questions: Is note time per session lower without poorer notes?

incremental.description: Art therapist reports systematic drafting errors to the application owner.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: group sessions with many corrections; high: individual sessions drafted well.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review assessment findings and goals, choose studio art therapy, counseling or psychotherapy techniques to develop individualized treatment plans, discuss the plan with the client, and write it down.

steps.what: Art therapist reviews assessment findings and agreed goals
Art therapist chooses studio art therapy, counseling or psychotherapy techniques for the individualized treatment plan
Art therapist discusses the plan with the client
Art therapist writes the plan down in the record

tasks.design: The client record shows assessment findings, artwork photos and agreed goals on one page, so reviewing them takes a little less time. Choosing techniques and agreeing the plan with the client stay with the therapist. Writing the plan document belongs to the plan-writing task and is priced there.
tasks.previous_blocker: Findings sat in separate notes and files.
tasks.still_hard: Clients whose needs change from week to week.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing a medium that lets this client say what words cannot.
tasks.altitude: Little changes; designing the plan stays.

evidence.claim: Records can show assessment findings and goals on one overview page.

assumptions: Boundary: developing plans; gathering client information (task 19158) and conferring with the team (task 19144) are sibling tasks.
s4 is part of writing treatment plans, which sibling task 19154 covers; its saving is counted there.
Choosing and discussing keep their full time.
unknowns: How scattered client information is today.

incremental.description: Art therapist keeps the overview layout useful.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: information already together; high: information spread over many files.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Arrange the consultation, establish goals or objectives for art therapy sessions in consultation with clients or site administrators, set the goals, and record them.

steps.what: Art therapist arranges the consultation with the client or site administrator
Art therapist consults with the client or site administrators about objectives for art therapy sessions
Art therapist sets the goals and objectives
Art therapist records the goals in the client record

tasks.design: Clients and site administrators pick a consultation time from the therapist's booking page instead of mailing back and forth. The consultation and setting goals stay personal. Goals are recorded in a goal module in the record with a fixed scale per goal, which later session notes and plans refer to, instead of free text in a document.
tasks.previous_blocker: Appointments took many mails and goals were free text.
tasks.enabler_now: Booking pages and goal modules in client records.
tasks.still_hard: Clients who cannot yet put a goal into words.
tasks.human_edge: Turning a vague wish into a goal the client owns.
tasks.altitude: Less arranging and typing; the conversation stays.

evidence.claim: Booking pages and goal modules are standard in practice software.

assumptions: Boundary: establishing session goals; writing treatment plans (task 19154) is a sibling task that uses these goals.
Input contract for s1: about 60% of clients and administrators use the booking page; s1 is priced at that share.
Consulting and setting goals keep their full time.
unknowns: Share of clients who book online.
research_questions: Are goals easier to track in later notes?

incremental.description: Art therapist keeps booking slots current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few clients booking online; high: most consultations booked online.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select artistic media suited to the session objectives, check supplies, prepare materials and equipment, and adapt tools for clients with physical limitations.

steps.what: Art therapist selects artistic media suited to the session objectives and client abilities
Art therapist checks which supplies are in stock
Art therapist prepares materials and equipment in the studio
Art therapist adapts tools and devices for clients with physical limitations

tasks.design: A simple stock list of studio supplies, updated when materials are used up, shows what is available without searching cupboards. Selecting media, preparing the studio and adapting tools stay hands-on. Ordering supplies belongs to another task and is priced there.
tasks.previous_blocker: Nothing blocked it; this is hands-on preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Media that dry out or spoil unnoticed.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing clay over paint for a client who needs to work with their hands.

reach.learn: Whether running out of materials happens less.

evidence.claim: Shared stock lists show available supplies without a physical check.

assumptions: Boundary: selecting and preparing media; recommending or purchasing supplies (task 19159) is a sibling task.
Selecting, preparing and adapting keep their full time.
unknowns: Whether colleagues keep the stock list current.
research_questions: Do sessions start on time more often?

incremental.description: Art therapist marks used-up supplies on the stock list.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a small studio; high: a shared studio with many users.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
